svg.text: 12 · The daily record: each person's amount, who paid the pizzeria, the export (organiser)
Redrawn for the plan: M2 and D7 B (amounts), M1 and U12 (who is paid), M4 (the export in the payment system's format, #633).
A · A day's orders

g.text: Paid by Player Two · via the organiser
Paid by Player Three · paid to them
Order 3 · edited after call-in (1 crew edit)

svg.text: B · One order's money
C · The export for the payment system

g.text: It has no total yet. Add it and export
again: the same orders are replaced.
Format: the pizza contract's export spec

svg.text: Each person's amount (M2, D7 B)
Exact when every pizza in the order has a price, from
the menu or the confirmed receipt: the person's prices
plus their part of the extras (delivery, discounts),
split per pizza. Otherwise even shares: the payment
system divides the total by the pizzas.
Who paid, and who is paid (U13, M1, U12)
The payer is always set. An order settles through the
organiser, or straight to the payer when the event
allows it and the holder chose it.
Flags
No total yet, edited after call-in, released,
cancelled after call-in, closed by the timer: each
from the order's history and the audit log (D16).
The export is the payment system's file (M4)
One row per person per order in the format of #633,
now a contract part. Export as often as needed: each
export holds the current state, and the payment system
replaces the rows of an order it already has (U14).
What is left out
Orders without a total are left out and named. An
order cancelled after an export is flagged here, so
the treasurer removes it in the payment system.
Right and privacy
pizza.record.read. Amounts never travel on the event
bus. Each person's amount is personal data, anonymised
12 months after the event (O6); totals stay.
